# Aperture geometry (crop, straighten, rotate, flip, perspective) and heal

- Kind: `editor`
- Category: `photo`
- Slug: `photo/geometry-heal`

## Summary

The Geometry panel transforms the whole photo once; Heal removes spots with an AI inpainting model.

## Details

- `rotate` (straighten/rotate angle in degrees): -360 to 360, default 0
- `flipH`: true/false, default false
- `flipV`: true/false, default false
- `perspective`: object
  - `tl`: object
    - `x`: -1 to 1, default 0
    - `y`: -1 to 1, default 0
  - `tr`: object
    - `x`: -1 to 1, default 0
    - `y`: -1 to 1, default 0
  - `br`: object
    - `x`: -1 to 1, default 0
    - `y`: -1 to 1, default 0
  - `bl`: object
    - `x`: -1 to 1, default 0
    - `y`: -1 to 1, default 0
- `crop` (crop rectangle in fractions): object
  - `x`: 0 to 0.999, default 0
  - `y`: 0 to 0.999, default 0
  - `width`: 0.001 to 1, default 1
  - `height`: 0.001 to 1, default 1
- `fill` (empty corners: transparent, edge or a hex colour): text, default "transparent"
Straighten by angle or by drawing a line along the horizon; rotate 90° steps and flip; perspective drags four corners; auto-crop removes the empty corners. Common crop aspects: 1:1, 4:5 (Instagram portrait), 3:2, 16:9, 9:16.
Heal: Paint over spots or blemishes, then press Heal. Healing runs on our GPU; this can take a minute. Each press of Heal is one AI job, so Medi suggests it as a button.
